adminPeople.description: Every member of a Figma TEAM with seat type, email and last-active, read from the team admin console on the logged-in tab (scrolls the virtualized grid, de-duplicates by email). Opens its own tab and closes it.

teamId.description: Numeric Figma team id from the /files/team/<id>/ URL.

adminPlan.description: The Settings > Plan block of the team admin console: 'Upgrade your plan' means the free Starter plan; a paid team shows its plan and seats. Opens its own tab and closes it.

returns.description: The Plan block text, first line to the Resources heading.

teamTree.description: Read-only tree of a Figma TEAM through its web API on the logged-in tab: top-level folders plus one level of subfolders, each with team_access, invite_only, roles (handle:level) and files (name, touched, link access, password flag); trashed rows skipped. Opens its own tab, navigates it once per top-level folder to discover subfolder ids (about 8 s each), and closes it.

teamId.description: Numeric Figma team id from the /files/team/<id>/ URL.

fuid.description: Digits-only Figma user id, appended as ?fuid= to page URLs to pick which logged-in account the tab uses.

returns.description: [{id, name, team_access, invite_only, roles:[handle:level], files:[{name, touched, link, pw}], subs:[same shape]}]
